scope.collision_and_out_penalties: fixed candidate-local additive penalties; all quality components remain present
scope.best_checkpoint_objective: strictly maximize validation/simulator_reward_mean; exact ties preserve the earlier checkpoint, including verified historical best across resume

continuous_safety_contract.timeline: 0.0 through 4.0 seconds inclusive, resampled at 0.1 seconds for proxy and simulator continuous risks
continuous_safety_contract.gap: tracking-aware oriented-box shared-corridor bumper gap; 7m platoon and 5m background thresholds; 0.5m stable-softplus softness
continuous_safety_contract.ttc: adjacent finite gap decrease; closing speed <=0.1m/s has no risk; 4s warning and 0.5s softness; no-risk values use a finite sentinel
continuous_safety_contract.road: signed DRIVABLE distance field with bilinear sampling; 1m warning and 0.25m softness; raster-filled physical footprint determines out-of-drivable
continuous_safety_contract.aggregation: alternative branches max within each actor, interactions max per time, then 0.7*time_max + 0.3*time_mean
continuous_safety_contract.hard_event_semantics: physical footprint and nominal background branch only; alternative branches affect continuous gap/TTC only
continuous_safety_contract.diagnostic_semantics: unsafe, clearance_violation, collision, and out_of_drivable remain diagnostics and do not branch reward or rank best checkpoints

implementation.calibration_contract: holdout is bound to the exact development-report SHA, Stage1 source SHA, variant, complete ordered S5-S9 contract, development/holdout seeds, trajectory optimizer, reward contract SHA, and reward config SHA
implementation.legacy_rejection: calibration v2, failed-calibration bypass, missing V2 checkpoint metadata, and run_3 resume are rejected
implementation.artifact_isolation: launcher defaults to reward_v2/calibration_v3, training_v2, and logs_v2 roots; legacy reports, run_3, and ROUND13_96_FREEZE.json are not overwritten
implementation.maintenance_gap: No dedicated Stage 2 reward specialist skill exists; implementation used the project workflow, project-plan, and simple-code gates.
